provenance_note: The existing stance labels are treated as the project reference targets. Source history is recorded in data/ai_labels/stance_sentiment_ai_v1/provenance.json; terminology does not assert independent human verification.
development_split_note: This run creates a new source-record and near-duplicate grouped test fold for this fit. However, the full reference pool has been exposed in prior development runs; treat results as development estimates, not an untouched independent evaluation.
selection_rule: validation macro-F1; ties use validation accuracy, then word-only over word+character, then lower C; test evaluated only after configurations frozen
multilingual_pretrained: not run in this fresh-split comparison; prior MiniLM comparison did not improve held-out results
